description: Read-only v1 strategy bank. Raw attempts belong in strategy_attempts.jsonl; only stable, reusable strategies should live here.

applies_when: The page contains repeated product/article/list cards.
Items expose stable anchors such as /ai/, /product/, /tool/, or article URLs.
Visual order matters, including multi-column grids.
avoid_tools: large AXTree as final data source
procedure: Open or reuse a page, then navigate with navigate_verified.
Use extract_dom_records on repeated anchors/cards with includeRect=true.
Sort rows by rect.y, then rect.x, then DOM order.
Filter/dedupe target rows and call record_extraction within one step.

applies_when: extract_dom_records cannot express the required relationship.
The target requires custom DOM traversal, computed style, or pageY/pageX sorting.
procedure: Use eval_js_json, not raw Runtime.evaluate, for structured JS return values.
Return JSON-serializable values only; do not return functions or DOM nodes.
Collect text, href, image alt, and bounding rect/page coordinates.
Call record_extraction immediately if rows are target data.

applies_when: A detail page contains named sections, tabs, anchors, reviews, FAQs, or pros/cons blocks.
avoid_tools: large AXTree as final data source
procedure: Use extract_dom_records for obvious repeated section rows.
Use eval_js_json for section-scoped text extraction when selectors are nested.
Persist a structured artifact with empty arrays for missing optional sections.

applies_when: The task requires filling standard form fields and submitting or saving.
procedure: Use AXTree to locate form controls and labels.
Use Page.getState and visual_verify only for outcome/layout verification.
